convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'FisherCyberCycle' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trading operations (position open/close, money management, new bar detection). Custom indicator cannot be auto-replicated without its source.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warm-up

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: Sell close on bullish crossover, Buy close on bearish crossover, gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input value serves as lot size when LOT mode, or as percentage fraction for margin-based modes.

custom_logic_notes: The crossover detection uses previous bar values (Ind[1] vs Sign[1]) to determine trend state, and current bar values (Ind[0] vs Sign[0]) to detect the actual cross event. Long entry requires Ind[1]>Sign[1] (prior bullish state) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (cross down at current bar) - this is a mean-reversion entry buying the dip within an uptrend. Short entry is the mirror. SignalBar input (default=1) allows evaluating on a confirmed bar; when SignalBar=0, the EA can trade on every tick without waiting for new bar. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on failed CopyBuffer calls. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime derived from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE+TimeShiftSec passed to position open functions (likely used for pending order logic or timing gates in TradeAlgorithms). GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Must implement FisherCyberCycle indicator from source (not available as built-in). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_) must be reimplemented - they encapsulate order execution, margin calculation, new-bar detection, and global variable cleanup. The MarginMode enum with 5 modes requires careful translation. Signal detection logic uses two buffers (Ind=main, Sign=signal line) with a specific crossover pattern that is counter-intuitive (enters long on bearish cross within uptrend - mean reversion style). SL/TP are in points not pips - verify point value for target symbol. Deviation=10 points for slippage control.
